news.title: Swapnil Madiyar cancelled the acquisition of 45.97% stake in Frontier Capital Limited (BSE:508980) from Inimitable Capital Finance Private Limited.
news.body:
Swapnil Madiyar agreed to acquire 45.97% stake in Frontier Capital Limited (BSE:508980) from Inimitable Capital Finance Private Limited for approximately INR 140 million on February 6, 2025. A cash consideration valued at INR 17.54 per share will be paid by the buyer. As part of consideration, INR 135.2 million is paid towards common equity of Frontier Capital Limited. In a separate agreement, Swapnil Madiyar agreed to acquire 5.55% to acquire in Frontier Capital Limited from Anirudh Bhuwalka. The completion of the deal will result in the board of the Frontier Capital Limited being reconstituted. The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee and consummation of tender offer.

news.title: Swapnil Madiyar cancelled the acquisition of 5.55% stake in Frontier Capital Limited (BSE:508980) from Anirudh Bhuwalka.
news.body:
Swapnil Madiyar agreed to acquire 5.55% stake in Frontier Capital Limited (BSE:508980) from Anirudh Bhuwalka for INR 16.3 million on February 6, 2025. A cash consideration valued at INR 17.54 per share will be paid by the buyer. As part of consideration, INR 16.3 million is paid towards common equity of Frontier Capital Limited. The completion of the deal will result in the board of the Frontier Capital Limited being reconstituted. The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee and consummation of tender offer.


Swapnil Madiyar terminated the acquisition of 5.55% stake in Frontier Capital Limited (BSE:508980) from Anirudh Bhuwalka on February 13, 2025.
